died.name: Isaac E. Avery
died.desc: Confederate officer of the American Civil War
died.cause: written on scrap of paper after being mortally wounded at the Battle of Gettysburg
died.last_words: Tell father that I died with my face to the enemy.

died.name: William Barksdale
died.desc: Confederate general of the American Civil War
died.cause: to a Union surgeon after being mortally wounded at the Battle of Gettysburg
died.last_words: Tell my wife I am shot, but we fought like hell.

died.name: Joel Chandler Harris
died.cause: on being asked how he felt
died.last_words: I am about the extent of a tenth of a gnat's eyebrow better.

died.name: Jim Morrison
died.desc: American singer, musician, songwriter and poet
died.last_words: Are you there, Pam? Pam, are you there?

born.name: Charlotte Perkins Gilman
born.last_words: When all usefulness is over, when one is assured of an unavoidable and imminent death, it is the simplest of human rights to choose a quick and easy death in place of a slow and horrible one.
